name: Perpetua
tagline: Plan a dignified farewell, all in one calm place.
positioning: Perpetua helps families plan, document, and share end-of-life arrangements without the stress of scattered paperwork and rushed decisions.

hero.h1: A calmer way to plan a meaningful goodbye
hero.sub: Perpetua guides you through funeral arrangements, wishes, and documents — so you make thoughtful decisions instead of scrambling through folders and phone calls in a hard week.

features.title: One living plan
features.description: Keep wishes, service details, readings, and vendor contacts in a single document your family can actually find when it matters.

features.title: Guided arrangements
features.description: Step-by-step prompts walk you through burial or cremation choices, budgets, and paperwork without the funeral-home pressure.

features.title: Share with trusted people
features.description: Invite family or an executor with granular permissions, so the right person sees the right details at the right time.

features.title: Cost clarity
features.description: Compare itemized quotes side by side and track deposits, so no one is surprised by fees during grief.

features.title: Secure vault
features.description: Store the will, insurance policies, and account logins with encryption and a legacy handoff you control.

features.title: Gentle reminders
features.description: Get nudged to revisit your plan after a move, marriage, or diagnosis — never spammy, always considerate.

testimonials.quote: After my father passed, we spent days piecing together what he wanted. With Perpetua my mother's wishes are written down, itemized, and shared. It removed a whole layer of panic.
testimonials.name: Helena Marsh

testimonials.quote: I recommend Perpetua to every family I sit down with. Their arrangement summaries arrive organized, so we spend our meeting on care instead of chasing missing details.
testimonials.name: Daniel Okafor

testimonials.quote: As an estate planner, I finally have a place to point clients for the emotional and logistical side. The document handoff to executors is genuinely well thought out.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

pricing.blurb: Everything one person needs to record their wishes.
For families coordinating plans across generations.
Pay once and keep your plan safe for good.

homepage.footerBlurb: Perpetua helps individuals and families plan dignified farewells with clarity and care. Built quietly, for the moments that matter most.
